en: The near future starts with aller. With je, it is je vais.
With nous, aller becomes allons, then comes the infinitive visiter.
After the form of aller, the second verb stays in the infinitive: manger.
After va, use the infinitive voir (to see).
After vont, the verb stays in the infinitive: regarder.
After allez, use the infinitive prendre (to take).
What does Je vais nager mean?
Je vais plus an infinitive talks about the future: I am going to swim.
What does Nous allons partir mean?
Nous allons plus partir means we are going to leave.
How do you say He is going to read in French?
Il va plus the infinitive lire means he is going to read. Il lit is now and il a lu is the past.
How do you say They are going to sing in French?
Use ils vont plus the infinitive chanter.
Which sentence talks about the future?
Je vais dormir means I am going to sleep. The others are present and past.
On uses va, and the second verb is the infinitive faire.
Ce soir, je vais ___ mes devoirs.
After je vais, use the infinitive faire.
Samedi, mes parents ___ acheter un vélo.
Mes parents means they, so aller becomes vont.
Weather uses faire. In the near future: il va faire beau.
Pleuvoir means to rain. After il va, use the infinitive.
After tu vas, use the infinitive ranger (to tidy).
Aller can follow itself: nous allons aller means we are going to go.
Ne … pas goes around vais, and the second verb stays in the infinitive.
Ne … pas goes around the form of aller: je ne vais pas manger.
After vont, use the infinitive prendre.
What does Vous allez gagner mean?
Vous allez plus gagner means you are going to win.
After je vais, use the infinitive appeler (to call).
How do you say We are going to eat at midday in French?
Use nous allons plus the infinitive manger. Nous avons mangé is the past.
Which word is the infinitive in Tu vas écrire une lettre?
Écrire (to write) is the infinitive that comes after vas.
L’été prochain, nous ___ voyager en Espagne.
The near future uses aller: nous allons voyager.
How do you say She is going to dance in French?
Elle va plus danser means she is going to dance.
In French you have an age, so you use avoir: il va avoir quinze ans.
Les enfants vont ___ dans le jardin.
After vont, use the infinitive jouer.
Qu’est-ce que tu vas ___ ce week-end ?
Qu’est-ce que tu vas faire ? means What are you going to do?

example.why_en: The near future starts with aller. With je, it is je vais.

en.title: The near future
en.teach: To say what is going to happen, use aller in the present plus a verb in the infinitive: Je vais manger. (I am going to eat.)
